title: Kenyan Smoked Hash
description: A hearty, smoky hash made with nourishing ingredients, inspired by Kenyan cuisine. Perfect for a satisfying breakfast or brunch.
instructions: Peel and dice sweet potatoes, then toss with smoked paprika, salt, and pepper.
Spread sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
Mince onions and garlic, then sauté in a pan until softened.
Add hash browns to the pan and stir to combine with onions and garlic.
Season with kenyan spices to taste.
Once sweet potatoes are done, chop into small pieces and add to the pan.
Stir to combine all ingredients and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
